description.value: Patina Brewing Co. is a multi-award-winning craft brewery and BBQ taproom in Port Coquitlam, recognized as the only brewery in the city to receive a BC Beer Award. The taproom pours a rotating lineup of craft beers — from the award-winning Italian Pilsner and Kolsch to seasonal collaborations like the TransLink-inspired Platform Pilsner, brewed with 100% Canadian ingredients from the Coquitlam watershed. Touring cyclists can refuel with BBQ food and a flight of locally crafted beer in a welcoming community gathering spot.

address.value: 2332 Marpole Avenue, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C 2A2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, active craft brewery and BBQ taproom in Port Coquitlam — the OSM community field incorrectly lists 'North Vancouver'. Phone 604-474-0025 matches between OSM and website, but the postal code differs (OSM: V3C 2A1, website contact page: V3C 2A2). The website's 'PATINA TO GO' navigation link confirms takeout is available; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the site content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business is in Port Coquitlam per the website title, address, and all content — likely an OSM mapping error.
Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V3C 2A1; website contact page shows V3C 2A2.
OSM name is 'Patina Brewing' but the business consistently uses 'Patina Brewing Co.' on its website.
Website front-page header says '2332 Marpole Street' while the contact page and OSM both say '2332 Marpole Avenue' — appears to be a typo on the website homepage.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating craft brewery and BBQ taproom with active website and confirmed contact details. A worthwhile stop for touring cyclists seeking food and locally brewed beer.
